character.name:
Pixel art character of a Vietnamese Yen The uprising soldier wearing a green tunic, brown pants, and a conical hat (non la), standing barefoot. 
Simple 8-bit retro game style, top-down view (south facing), natural colors, soft shading, transparent background.
